name: uhoh-dominoes
description: Uh Oh Dominoes — server-authoritative multiplayer straight dominoes.

scripts.dev: npm run build:rules && concurrently -n rules,server,web -c yellow,blue,green "tsc -p packages/rules --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev -w @uhoh/server" "npm run dev -w @uhoh/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:rules && tsc -p packages/server && npm run build -w @uhoh/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/rules --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
